title: New & Trending
descriptionHtml:
New & Trending Beds

A selection of designs from the Eagle Bed range that we are featuring: statement headboards, panel, wingback and Chesterfield styles. Every bed is handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire on a solid wood frame, in your choice of fabric.

How to choose a bed

Think about headboard height and shape

Taller headboards add presence in larger rooms; lower designs suit smaller rooms or lower ceilings. Check the measurements on each product page and the wall space you have.

Pick your fabric

Upholstered to order in fabrics including Plush Velvet, Chenille and Teddy Bouclé. Velvet gives a smooth, rich look; bouclé and chenille have a softer, textured feel. Order free swatches before you decide.

Sizes

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT), Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT).

Looking for a particular type?

Browse upholstered beds, wingback beds, panel beds, Chesterfield beds, ottoman beds or headboards.

Frequently asked questions

Are all designs available in every size?

Our beds are made in Single to Super King; check each product page for the sizes and options offered.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery across Great Britain is free (Northern Ireland £90) and made by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Delivery to Jersey, Guernsey and the Isle of Man is £90.

What warranty do I get?

Every Eagle Bed comes with a 5-year warranty. See our warranty page for the full terms.

Can I see the fabric before I order?

Yes. We post free fabric swatches so you can check colour and texture in your own light. Request free swatches.

Can I pay in instalments?

Klarna and Clearpay are available. See our finance options.

Handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire · solid wood frames · free delivery across Great Britain (Northern Ireland £90) by our own team, usually in 3–5 working days · 5-year warranty · free fabric swatches · Klarna and Clearpay available. Questions? Call 07417 439197 or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.
